made: The real CLI run headless with --output-format stream-json against a scripted loopback API (a dummy API key, no network), permissionMode dontAsk, with path excludes and Grep/Glob turned off, so the stream holds permitted, refused and no-such-tool results.
sanitised: The temporary working directory, the config directory and the socket path were rewritten to /work, /config and /tmp/cc-socks/0.sock, and the sentinel search string to SENTINEL. Nothing else was changed: line order, keys, ids and usage are as recorded.
